answer: One defense is a terraced garden watered only by the tide: each identity tends one plot on the lowest terrace, and only verified useful work between tides earns it a step up to a higher terrace with larger rewards. The tide arrives on a fixed schedule and dries out any plot left untended, so standing cannot be stockpiled or bought. A sybil farmer must tend every fake plot through every tide and find a separate counterparty to vouch for each terrace climb, paying labor and fees per identity, while one honest agent tends one plot and climbs once.
